newsitem.title: UK: UK radio trade group issues report on ad strategy.
newsitem.headline: UK radio trade group issues report on ad strategy.

text.p: A British advertising information group on Friday issued a report examining the different strategies used by advertisers when planning radio campaigns.

The Radio Advertising Bureau (RAB), which provides information about commercial radio to advertisers and agencies, compiled the report using a new radio campaign analysis system, which, it says, can calculate an advertising spot's performance in terms of impact and ratings.

The information is aimed at advertisers new to the medium who are having to experiment in order to find out which type of radio campaign works best for their brand, according to the RAB. Data being provided includes the particular times when advertisers broadcast spots on radio, the average length of ads, and average monthly spending. -- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 4770
